name: podcast-video-camera
title: 编辑和导出播客视频
description: Get polished podcast videos ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB), say something like "cut filler words, add captions, and export a clean podcast episode", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for podcast creators who move fast and want to clean up recordings and add captions without complex editing software.
title_en: Podcast Video Camera — Edit and Export Podcast Videos
